confidence_notes: Holistic estimates from general knowledge of Hobart and Australian pricing for July 2026. Restaurant and coffee anchors are moderately certain; accommodation and drink anchors are less certain. No live listings or booking pages were checked. July is Tasmanian winter, so accommodation reflects a cooler, lower-demand period than summer. The FX observation comes from search result snippets that cite RBA figures. I did not open the RBA page directly, so verify the value and date on rba.gov.au before use. The 16 October figure may be provisional.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on mid-sized Australian tourism cities such as Adelaide, Canberra and Perth, adjusted for Hobart's smaller market and July winter demand. For cocktail and wine, I used the local price relationship to beer (cocktail about 2.3x and wine glass about 1.35x the draft beer price) because direct knowledge of those prices is weaker.
